text: Yes, but the changes become topics to decide on, not finished posts. In TextOS, a change from the repository enters by a single path, is judged by a single rule and becomes content through a single chain. The topics that come out of it start life as proposals, and TextOS accepts none of them without a human decision. From there, a change becomes an article only through the same accepted brief as any other subject, so a product update is held to the same standard as an article planned by your marketing team. You stop retyping release notes, and you keep the final say.
